# Code Commenting & Inline Documentation Standards

## Backend (Java / Javadoc)
- Document public APIs, service methods, and domain models using standard Javadoc.
- Focus comments on **why** something was done, not **what** (let clean code explain the what).
- Include `@param`, `@return`, and `@throws` tags for service .
- layer public methods.

## Frontend (TypeScript / TSDoc)
- Provide TSDoc on shared hooks, state stores, and utility functions.
- Add prop interface documentation for reusable UI components so IntelliSense shows helpful tooltips.
